data.description: Get a great haircut for $14.99  only at participating Buffalo area Great Clips salons.  To redeem the offer now, click “Redeem Now” and present this offer on your phone at the time of payment. To redeem the offer later, just enter your email and click “Save for Later”.
data.terms_and_conditions: Valid only at participating Buffalo area Great Clips salons.  Not valid with any other offer. Limit one coupon per customer. No copies. Taxes may apply. Offer expires 09/11/2026. All Great Clips® salons are independently owned and operated.
